messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum achievable minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is exactly 1/144, attained by placing the 13 points at coordinates {(i/12, 0) : 0 ≤ i ≤ 12} ∪ {(i/12 + 1/24, 1) : 0 ≤ i ≤ 11}, forming two staggered horizontal rows of 12 and 11 points respectively. Every triangle formed by three collinear points has area 0, and since no placement of 13 points in the square can avoid producing three collinear points, the infimum of the minimum triangle area over all configurations is 0, making this the extremal configuration that achieves this sharp bound."}
